description: Search and read project context from a local database you choose, scoped to one project.
name: canon-local

context_db.description: Absolute SQLite file path with an existing parent folder. The read-only profile requires an existing Canon database.
context_db.title: Canon context database

context_write.description: Allow ingestion into the selected database and scope. May initialize a new database. Purge remains unavailable.
context_write.title: Allow context writes

project_id.description: Explicit project scope for this connection. This is a data selector, not authentication.
project_id.title: Project ID

workspace_id.description: Explicit workspace scope for this connection. This is a data selector, not authentication.
workspace_id.title: Workspace ID
